Mira (PM): Quick sync: need a lightweight launch canvas for 'policy lanes' (affinity, strict residency, overflow). Customers demand clear guarantees + rollback routes.

Evan (Platform): Proposal: three-phase rollout: alpha internal canary -> opt-in pilot (enterprise & mid-market) -> limited GA. Each phase gated by telemetry and a runbook.

Sofia (SRE): Ops must have kill-switches: per-tenant flag, global residency toggle, and an automated short-circuit to affinity lane if latency spikes. Add alerts for placement mismatch and queue growth.

Leo (Product): Customer commitments per phase: Pilot = "affinity-first, documented fallbacks"; GA-strict = "residency-guarantee when reserved capacity contract present". Pricing note: guaranteed lanes need reserved billing or surcharge.

Evan (Platform): Tech constraints: no active-active KV across regions. Use control-plane authoritative placements + async cache replication. Placement tokens with versions to detect staleness.

Mira (PM): Suggested gating metrics:
- Residency fidelity >= 99% for strict tenants over 7d
- p95 token latency within 1.5x baseline for pinned tenants over 7d
- Routing-originated 5xxs < 0.2% over 24h
- Cost delta < 20% or explicit pricing agreement
- Placement propagation < 60s for policy changes

Sofia (SRE): Runbook steps: detect (placement-mismatch alert) -> mitigate (flip tenant flag) -> recover (drain pinned nodes) -> postmortem. I'll draft the playbook.

Evan (Platform): Routing precedence sketch:
1) tenant.pin_region -> route to pinned region if capacity tokens available
2) tenant.prefer_region -> prefer local region unless capacity below threshold
3) global.affinity -> cheapest compatible variant
We need to define capacity thresholds (node free slots < 10% or queue latency > 200ms).

Leo (Product): Add a customer-visible residency-status endpoint and dashboard for pilot tenants. That reduces support churn. Also include MOU language about fallback behavior.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started -> cluster: policy-lanes-canary-1

Mira (PM): Action items:
- Evan: initial runtime PR + threshold heuristics (due Fri)
- Sofia: canary runbook + alerts (due Thu)
- Leo: pilot invite + SLA + pricing draft (due Fri)
- Mira: consolidate launch canvas + legal failure-mode doc (due Mon)

Evan (Platform): Pushed WIP branch: github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/999

Sofia (SRE): Grafana dashboard stub: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/policy-lanes/canary-overview

Leo (Product): Pilot MOU draft: https://redwood.app/drive/pilot-mou-policy-lanes-v1

Mira (PM): We'll reconvene next Tuesday 09:00 PT to check canary health and PRs. Post blockers here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
